messages:
sre-oncall: raising an incident — seeing a spike of 5xx and timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-west2 starting ~03:14 UTC. multiple customers (notably AcmeCorp, support #12345) reporting 502/504 and long tail latencies.

amanda-support: on customer call, they report intermittent timeouts on /v1/generate, usually after a few tokens. set of requests return 502 Bad Gateway, some 504s. forwarding their sample logs. :frowning:

amanda-support: ```curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":16}'``` -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

ira-infra: infra metrics: gateway->inference tail latency jumps at 03:13:20 UTC. egress retransmit rate from us-west2-azb increased, TCP retransmits and RTOs. packet loss on cross-AZ path ~2.5-3% for a ~7m window.

net-ops: running BGP/peering checks now. initial glance shows flaps on transit peer ASN 64512 between sfo-transit-a and sfo-transit-b, withdrawing/announcing same prefixes every ~30s. opened upstream contact.

sre-oncall: can we carve critical customers to a different path or dedicated pool until this stabilizes? @net-ops @ira-infra

net-ops: deploying temporary route preference to avoid the flaky POP (propagating). ETA ~2m. also asked provider for pcap and RTC logs.

monitor-bot: [ALERT] gateway_5xx_rate us-west2-hosted > 5% over 5m (threshold breached)

ira-infra: stack traces show repeated TLS handshake retries between gateway and inference nodes, and KV cache misses (likely due to repeated connections). connection churn causing backend pressure.

amanda-support: repro steps for customers: spawn 10 concurrent low-latency requests (seq len ~64) to /v1/generate, ~30% of runs see 502/timeout locally. sharing snippet to reproduce.

erin-cs: informed AcmeCorp of mitigations, offered temporary failover to a dedicated cluster; they accepted.

sre-oncall: mitigation actions taken: 1) migrated AcmeCorp to dedicated pool (immediate). 2) applied route preference to edge -> avoids flaky POP. 3) increased gateway retry count to 3 for hosted path (rolling config).

ira-infra: verified AcmeCorp traffic on ded pool — their error rate dropped to <1% and tail latency normalized for their sessions. overall us-west2 errors trending down but still noisy.

net-ops: provider acknowledged and is investigating BGP flaps — suspect a misconfig during a maintenance window on their sfo-transit cluster. provider ticket PROV-8642 opened, they will share pcap/adj logs.

sre-oncall: next steps: collect MTRs from multiple POPs to the affected GW, get pcap from provider, save reproducer, plan postmortem. add a permanent fallback policy for enterprise customers and document.

amanda-support: recorded incident in support tracker: #12345-INC, customer updated. they asked for RCA once provider confirms root cause.

sre-oncall: reproducer saved for engineering: ```python
import requests
for i in range(10):
    r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACT'}, json={'prompt':'hello','max_tokens':10})
    print(i, r.status_code, len(r.content))
```

net-ops: provider ticket PROV-8642 — they are capturing pcap and BGP adj timeline.

monitor-bot: [NOTICE] gateway_5xx_rate us-west2-hosted returned to baseline after route preference change

sre-oncall: incident mitigated for impacted customers. keeping ticket open until provider confirms root cause and we have postmortem notes. tagging postmortem owners: net-ops, infra, support, cs.

erin-cs: customer closed interim call, wants RCA and mitigation timeline.

amanda-support: closing customer loop, will include timeline and mitigation steps in the RCA.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone — followup: collect PCAPs, run full routing diff, and schedule postmortem within 48h.
